intent: wall-mounted mail and key organizer with a back board, shallow mail pocket, key hooks, and wall mounting holes

must_have: mail pocket or shallow shelf sized for envelopes
row of key hooks below the pocket
staged instructions that do not show fully assembled parts before they are installed

success_criteria: The local model searches or lists reusable components before generating a design.
The design combines multiple component families where possible.
If no reusable mail pocket, shelf lip, or bin component exists, the model requests that missing reusable building block instead of requesting a one-off mail organizer.
The final response clearly distinguishes existing components used from missing components requested.
